methods.deployed: the deployed network (lagging batch-norm statistics: fails safe)
methods.source: the same recipe with settled statistics (precise BN): the starting point of every adaptation
methods.adabn: batch-norm statistics re-estimated on unlabelled frames of the new line
methods.adabn, balanced: the same, frames balanced by the network's own predictions
methods.tent: entropy minimisation on unlabelled frames (batch-norm scale and shift), after AdaBN
methods.self-training: final layers fine-tuned on the network's confident answers
methods.few labels: final layers fine-tuned on 10 labelled frames per condition, old images replayed
methods.retrained: trained from scratch on old + new conditions

meta.limits: rendered images only: the method, not the accuracy on a real camera
